name: DeployStatus - Publishing, Dismissible
description: The deploy panel mid-build — the 1-3 minutes a GitHub Actions build takes. The button on the right is the change: it reads 'Keep editing' and it is enabled. It previously read 'Working…' and was disabled until the deploy reached a terminal stage, inside a fixed full-screen scrim; on this site the watch could never reach one, so publishing locked the whole admin until the page was reloaded. Closing now demotes this to a chip and the watch continues.
